usages.explain: ✦ Used in cases to express something contrary to the hypothesis, even though it's supposed to be like this, in reality it's like that.

examples.content: １２月に入ったとはいえ、まだ年末という気がしない。
examples.transcription: じゅうにがつにはいったとはいえ、まだねんまつというきがしない。
examples.mean: Even though it's December, it still doesn't feel like the end of the year.

examples.content: 時間がなかったとはいえこのぐらいのレポートが書けないはずがない
examples.transcription: じかんがなかったとはいえこのぐらいのレポートがかけないはずがない
examples.mean: Even though I didn't have time, there's no way I couldn't write a report like this.

usages.mean: though; although; be that as it may; nonetheless
usages.synopsis:

✦N + とはいえ

title: ～とはいえ      => though; although; be that as it may; nonetheless
